summary: Iteration 8 (per-duty class checklist + class-scoped guru): Backend 16/16 pytest cases pass. Frontend Playwright end-to-end verified: admin can create a guru via /akun with mapel chips (form-user-mapel-*), teaching-class chips (form-user-teaching-class-*), duty toggle (form-user-duty-tabungan) reveals per-duty class checklist (form-user-duty-tabungan-class-*); saved via save-user-btn and the new guru appears in table with the correct mapel/teaching/duty_classes persisted. Edit modal (edit-user-<id>) re-opens with the same chip prefixes prefilled. New guru logs in via username and GET /api/classes returns ONLY 1A (scoping verified). Sidebar shows Tabungan (has duty) and hides Program Tahfidz (no duty). Backend RBAC covered: classes filtered, subjects filtered by mapel_ids, students 403 on other class / 200 on assigned, assessments 403 for wrong class & wrong subject / 200 when both assigned, ledger 403 on other class, savings summary rows only for 1A, POST /api/savings 403 for non-1A student & 200 for 1A student, POST /api/tahfidz 403 without tahfidz duty. Regressions: admin sees all 12 classes and can assess any class; demo guru (guru@mijannah.sch.id) as wali of 1A auto-includes 1A even without teaching_class_ids; username login for admin, email login for demo guru, username validation 400, change-password guru 403 all still pass. All created test users cleaned up via DELETE /api/users/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_teacher._guru_can_grade: when guru has empty mapel_ids and subject_id is provided, currently allowed (mp truthy check). This may be intentional (unassigned mapel = allow) but could also be interpreted as 'guru mapel required'. Confirm with product intent.
routes_master.list_subjects: guru with empty mapel_ids sees ALL subjects (mp truthy check skips filter). Consider whether guru without mapel_ids should see none or all.
routes_teacher.list_journals filters by teacher_id even for admin? No, admin path skipped -- OK. But guru with no teacher_id linked will see nothing regardless of duty; acceptable.

Guru dashboard shows 'Total Tahfidz: 41' for a guru with no tahfidz duty (scoped guru we created). Not blocking but the metric may leak counts from outside guru's scope; consider filtering dashboard cards by accessible classes.
Sidebar shows 'Wali Kelas' section (Absensi Kelas, Manajemen Kelas) for any guru even if they are not a wali_kelas; may want to hide when user.teacher_id has no wali class.
seed_data_creation: Test users (uitest*, testg8_*) created in fixtures & Playwright are cleaned up via DELETE /api/users/{id}. Assessments/savings created in tests are also deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration8.py covers create_user with new fields (duty_classes, mapel_ids, teaching_class_ids), update_user rescope, guru scoping across classes/subjects/students/assessments/ledger/savings/tahfidz, admin non-scoping, and demo guru wali auto-include. Playwright verified the Users.jsx GuruAssignments component (Chips + per-duty checklist) with data-testids form-user-mapel-<sid>, form-user-teaching-class-<cid>, form-user-duty-<duty>, form-user-duty-<duty>-class-<cid>, and edit-user-* equivalents.
